notes.title: Announce our new project - a nonlinear visual horror novel "Yellow House."
notes.content:
Hello, friends!

Thank you for your interest in our visual novel "Outside the Door."

We are excited to announce our new project - a nonlinear visual horror novel "Yellow House." Prepare for an engaging story filled with even more mysteries and nightmares.

Work on the novel is in full swing. [b]Add "Yellow House" to your wishlist and stay tuned for updates.[/b]

Thank you for your support, and get ready for the horrors that await you in "Yellow House."

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3023880/Yellow_House/
